intent_en: To explain the sources of public transit funding in the United States and emphasize the importance of local and state elections for transit policy.
previous_intent: To illustrate the composition of public transit funding in the United States, emphasizing that local and state governments and fares are the primary sources to highlight the importance of local elections.
narration_support: which makes state and local elections super important for public transit
chart_support: Pie chart displaying the breakdown of public transit funding into Federal, State, Local government, and Fares categories
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links the funding structure (local/state/fares) to the political significance of elections. The chart visualizes this funding breakdown, showing local government and fares as major contributors alongside state and federal funds.
